Any other request type performs nothing and leaves the response code unchanged.

results.claim: Keep the highest return code across calls When a new return code is set ('S'), if it is greater than the highest code recorded so far (RC-HIGHEST-CODE) it becomes the new highest code; otherwise the highest code is kept. In both cases the current code becomes the new code. The highest code is held in the caller's request area, so it persists only as long as the caller keeps that area.
